Good news - the single RIGHT action worked! The agent moved from (2,0) to (2,2). No game over. The step counter went from 36 to 37.
But the Python tool timed out after 30s. This is likely because the loop was trying to execute 7 actions, and each action takes some time. The tool only executed 1 action before timing out.

Let me try batching 3 actions and see what happens.

<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Check agent position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
block_rows = [22, 25, 28, 31, 34]
block_cols = [13, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, 40, 43, 46, 49]
blue_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
for n in blue_nodes:
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    br = next(i for i, y in enumerate(block_rows) if abs(center_r - y) < 2)
    bc = next(j for j, x in enumerate(block_cols) if abs(center_c - x) < 2)
    print(f"Agent at ({br}, {bc}), step={current_frame.step}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
